pages.name: Portfolio: by stage (home page)
pages.what: The home page. A stage board with one column per pipeline stage (Reconnaissance, Target generation, Drilling, Resource definition, Scoping study, Stage-gate decision); each column head shows how many projects are in that stage and their committed and forecast fiscal-year spend, and each ticket under it is one project. Under the board, the Needs attention ledger lists what needs action across the portfolio: approvals overdue or due within seven days, tenements expiring within ninety days, batches on QAQC hold, programmes past the variance threshold, projects whose gate is near, and unfilled project roles. At the bottom, the Active projects register.
pages.not_here: Other cuts of the same projects (by commodity, by jurisdiction, analytics, budget) are in the left column under Shape. A project's own record, tenure and programmes are in Projects (a ticket or a project id opens it). Acting on an approval: the request's own page in Approvals (each ledger item links to it). Changing records: each record's own page.

leads_to.Stage column head: projects register cut to that stage
leads_to.Needs attention item: the approval, tenure, batch or project it is about

(() => { try { const out = []; for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('#content form input, #content form select, #content form textarea')) {  if (e.type === 'hidden' || e.type === 'submit' || e.type === 'button') continue;  let label = e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';  if (!label) { const f = e.closest('label'); const s = f && f.querySelector('span'); label = s ? s.textContent.trim() : ''; }  if (!label) { const f = e.closest('label'); label = f ? f.textContent.replace(e.value || '', '').trim() : ''; }  if (!label) { const r = e.closest('tr'); label = r && r.cells[0] ? r.cells[0].textContent.trim() : (e.name || 'field'); }  let value;  if (e.type === 'checkbox' || e.type === 'radio') value = e.checked ? 'on' : 'off';  else if (e.tagName === 'SELECT') value = [...e.selectedOptions].map(o => o.label).join(', ');  else value = JSON.stringify(e.value);  out.push(label + ' = ' + value + (e.disabled ? ' (read-only here)' : '')); } return out.length ? 'Form fields: ' + out.join('; ') : null } catch (e) { return null } })()

pages.what: The bell's drop-down: your latest notifications, unread ones first marked, each a link to the record it is about, with Mark all read, Notification settings and All notifications. It stays open over the page; the bell closes it again.

pages.name: Account menu
pages.what: The drop-down under your avatar in the top bar: who is signed in and their role, links to My profile, Preferences, Notification settings and the User Manual, and, in a demonstration tenant, a Switch user list that changes who is signed in. Working as another person, or with a role the signed-in user does not hold, is done here: pick that person under Switch user (People and roles lists who holds each role).
pages.not_here: Security (sign-in method and sessions): the left column of any My account page. The theme switch: the separate button at the far right of the top bar.

controls.what: The ADIT mark at the far left. Returns to the Portfolio home page (the stage board).
controls.not_for: Opening the user manual (the question-mark button) or any other section (the section links next to it).

controls.what: Keyboard shortcut link that moves focus past the top bar to the page's main content.
controls.not_for: Navigating to another page; focus moves within this page.

controls.what: Opens the Portfolio section: the home page with every active project by stage, what needs attention, and other cuts (by commodity, by jurisdiction, analytics, budget).
controls.not_for: A single project's record, which is in Projects.
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Projects section: the register of exploration projects and each project's record (tenure, programmes, team, budget, gates).
controls.not_for: The portfolio-wide overview (Portfolio) or field work on a project (Programmes).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Programmes section: units of field or study work on a project (drilling, geochemistry, geophysics, mapping, metallurgy, environmental baseline) with their budgets, phases, crews and logistics.
controls.not_for: Individual drillholes (Drilling) or laboratory results (Assays).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Drilling section: every drillhole in the tenant across projects and programmes, and the rigs.
controls.not_for: Assay results of the samples from a hole (Assays) or a programme's budget (Programmes).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Assays section: sample batches sent to laboratories, the results that come back, and QAQC checks.
controls.not_for: Resource estimates built from the results (Resources).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Resources section: resource estimates and what they are worth under the price deck.
controls.not_for: Assay batches (Assays) or portfolio budget figures (Portfolio, Budget).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Optimiser section: choosing which candidate drill targets to fund under a budget and rig-day limit, with saved scenarios.
controls.not_for: Approving programmes (Approvals) or reviewing spend (Portfolio, Budget).
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Admin section: tenant administration (users, system settings, workflows), available depending on role.
controls.not_for: Your own profile or preferences, which are in the account menu.
controls.note: Keyed on the link text; a breadcrumb link with the same text leads to the same section.

controls.what: Opens the Approvals section: the queue of workflow requests (programme approvals, budget variances, purchase orders, tenure renewals, resource releases). The number in its name is how many requests are waiting on your role.
controls.not_for: Notifications about approvals (the bell). Deciding a request: the request's own page in this section.

controls.what: Search box for the whole tenant: matches any part of an id (project, programme, hole, batch, approval request, estimate, tenement) and any word of a name; sample numbers match from five digits. Pressing Enter opens the Search results page, where the matches are listed.
controls.not_for: Filtering the table on the current page: that page's own filters. This box searches the whole tenant.

controls.what: The bell. Its name says how many notifications are unread. Opens and closes the notification tray with the latest notifications.
controls.not_for: Changing which notifications you receive (Notification settings) or the approvals queue (Approvals).

controls.what: Your avatar; its name says who is signed in. Opens and closes the account menu (profile, preferences, notification settings, user manual, and Switch user). Opening it is the way to act as another person or with another role: Switch user signs in as the person who holds it.

controls.what: Opens My profile: phone, location, time zone.
controls.not_for: Display preferences (Preferences).

controls.what: Opens Preferences: start section, default project, units, date format, grade decimals, rows per page, compact tables.
controls.not_for: Notification choices (Notification settings) or the theme (top bar).

controls.what: Opens Notification settings: which kinds of notification reach you and the email digest.
controls.not_for: Reading notifications (the bell or the Notifications page).

controls.what: Opens Security: how you sign in and your active sessions.
controls.not_for: Changing your password: the company identity provider.

controls.what: Marks every notification as read and clears the bell's count.
controls.not_for: Opening the full list (All notifications).

controls.what: Opens Notification settings: which kinds of notification reach you and the email digest.
controls.not_for: Reading notifications (the items above, or All notifications).

controls.what: Opens the Notifications page with the complete list.
controls.not_for: Changing which notifications you receive (Notification settings).

controls.what: Recent notification. Opens the record it is about.
controls.not_for: Marking notifications read: Mark all read in the tray.
controls.note: Keyed on notification title wording (templates, not records); a notification kind not in the pattern keeps its bare label.

controls.what: Opens My profile: your phone, location and time zone.
controls.not_for: Switching to another user (the Switch user list below).

controls.what: Opens Preferences: start section, default project, units, date format, grade decimals, rows per page, compact tables.
controls.not_for: The colour theme (the top-bar theme switch).

controls.what: Opens Notification settings: which kinds of notification reach you and the email digest.
controls.not_for: Reading notifications (the bell).

controls.what: Opens the ADIT User Manual in a new browser tab.
controls.not_for: Your account settings.

controls.what: Signs in as this person (name and role code), to act as them or with their role: what you can see and act on, and which approvals await you, follow the role. The current user is the highlighted entry.
controls.not_for: Editing that person's account (Admin) or opening their profile.
controls.note: Generic key: every Switch user entry; the trailing role code is what the key relies on.

controls.what: Your phone number, shown to colleagues.
controls.not_for: Your name or email, which are set in the company identity provider.

controls.what: Your office or base location.
controls.not_for: Your time zone (the next field).

controls.what: Your time zone, as a region name.
controls.not_for: Date format (Preferences).

controls.what: Saves the profile fields; a short confirmation message appears.
controls.not_for: Saving preferences or notification settings, which have their own Save buttons on their own pages.

controls.what: On/off switch for Approvals notifications in ADIT: sent when a workflow step is waiting on your role, or a request you raised was decided. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for Assays notifications in ADIT: sent when a batch is received, placed on hold, accepted or rejected on a project you work on. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for Tenure notifications in ADIT: sent when a tenement is within 90 days of expiry or a renewal changes state. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for Programmes notifications in ADIT: sent when crew assignments, rig moves, phase changes and gate decisions. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for Budget notifications in ADIT: sent when a programme forecast crosses the variance threshold. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for Mentions and comments notifications in ADIT: sent when someone mentions you or comments on a record you own. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: On/off switch for System notifications in ADIT: sent when maintenance windows, releases and account notices. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: The other kinds, which have their own switches, or the email digest (the select below).

controls.what: How often a summary email is sent: none, daily or weekly. Takes effect on Save.
controls.not_for: Which notifications appear in ADIT (the switches above).

controls.what: Saves the notification switches and the email digest.
controls.not_for: Marking notifications read (the Notifications page).

controls.what: The section ADIT opens on when you sign in; takes effect on Save preferences.
controls.not_for: The page you are on now.

controls.what: A project pre-selected where a page needs one, or none.
controls.not_for: Watching a project (that is done on the project's page).

controls.what: Metric or imperial units for display only; stored values do not change.
controls.not_for: Currency, which is the tenant's base currency.

controls.what: How dates are written across ADIT (year first, day first or month first).
controls.not_for: Your time zone (My profile).

controls.what: How many decimal places assay grades are shown with.
controls.not_for: Rounding of money or metres.

controls.what: Page size of long tables.
controls.not_for: Compact row height (Compact tables).

controls.what: Tighter row spacing in tables.
controls.not_for: The number of rows per page (Rows per page).

controls.what: Saves every preference on this page; a short confirmation appears.
controls.not_for: The theme, which is the top-bar switch and needs no save.

controls.what: Ends the session of that other device (the row it is on).
controls.not_for: This browser's own session, which stays signed in; each Sign out acts on the other device in its row.

controls.what: A section of the user manual, numbered as in the contents. Opens that section.
controls.not_for: Opening the application page of the same name: that section of the application (Back to ADIT leads there).
controls.note: Generic key: every contents entry.

controls.what: Leaves the manual and returns to the application (Portfolio).
controls.not_for: Going to the previous manual section.

controls.what: Opens the next section of the manual.
controls.not_for: Returning to the application (Back to ADIT).

controls.what: Opens the previous section of the manual.
controls.not_for: Returning to the application (Back to ADIT).

controls.what: Opens the Portfolio home page.
controls.not_for: Recovering the address typed; every section: the top-bar links.
